result.summary:
INT-networking-recovery adversarial run against 30a4065036a917514fb4984fde73f87867f38619 (branch devin/pp/adv/networking-recovery-30a40650 @ 08f5d87f16030f6b3a3685feb81689124cdfc48f, pushed, no PR, no force-push). No production source or existing test was modified; new files: apps/mobile/__tests__/adv/networkingRecovery.{transportBounds,retryAfter,hostileBodies}.adv.test.ts, supabase/functions/api/__wf__/adv_networking_recovery.test.ts, evidence logs + COMMANDS.txt under docs/evidence/adv/INT-networking-recovery/.

RUN COUNTS (VERIFIED, all on Linux, Node v24.19.0 / Deno 2.9.6): mobile transportBounds 19 failed/4 passed/23 total exit=1; mobile retryAfter 2 failed/2 passed/4 exit=1; mobile hostileBodies 3 failed/3 passed/6 exit=1; edge adv_networking_recovery 8 passed/3 failed exit=1. Failures are the intended adversarial assertions, classified into the 7 breaks above (the 19 transportBounds failures collapse to 3 breaks: 9 redirect-hygiene sites + 3 redirected-trust cases, 2 hung-header sites, 4 stalled-body sites + keeper). Hygiene on the new files: `cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit` exit=0; `pnpm format:check` exit=0; `pnpm lint` exit=0; `deno lint`/`deno check --config deno.json adv_networking_recovery.test.ts` exit=0; frozen edge check `npx --yes deno@2.5.6 check --node-modules-dir=none --frozen --lock=deno.lock supabase/functions/api/index.ts` exit=0 (edge.frozen_check.log). Existing controls still green: `cd apps/mobile && npx jest --ci __tests__/offlineNetwork.test.ts __tests__/sessionKeeperShortLife.test.ts __tests__/xcBehavioral/syncRuntimeMatrix.test.ts __tests__/authDurableSession.test.ts` → 164 passed/164 exit=0 (mobile.baseline_controls.log); `cd supabase/functions/api/__wf__ && deno test -A --no-check --config deno.json rateLimit.test.ts cache.test.ts` → 37 passed/0 failed exit=0 (edge.baseline_controls.log).

ATTACKS THAT DID NOT BREAK ANYTHING (passing = evidence, VERIFIED):
1. 429 does not consume the outbox attempt budget; row stays durable, stored reason is the server sentence — `npx jest --ci __tests__/adv/networkingRecovery.retryAfter.adv.test.ts -t 'control: a 429'`.
2. Permit reservation 429 → exactly one request, typed ApiError(429, rate_limited), no client retry storm, no sync launched — same file, -t 'permit reservation 429'.
3. Captive-portal 200 text/html on /v1/shots:sync → no receipt, attempts=0 (parseShotSyncAcknowledgement rejects non-JSON/non-ack) — hostileBodies -t 'captive portal 200'.
4. Gateway 502 text/html → transient, attempts=0, stored reason is not a JSON parser error — hostileBodies -t 'gateway 502'.
5. Offline→online: 3 drains of TypeError('Network request failed') keep attempts=0, next online drain syncs both rows and receipts them — hostileBodies -t 'offline'.
6. data/api.ts request(): headers arrive then body stalls → ApiError(408, network.timeout) at exactly 20 000 ms; billing/accessApi.ts settles at 10 000 ms — transportBounds -t 'control'.
7. Malformed Retry-After (HTTP-date, fractional, negative) from auth upstream → edge falls back to Retry-After: 2 — edge adv -t 'HTTP-date'.
8. Auth upstream 429 → client sees retryable 503 + Retry-After, bearer is not treated as invalid (no sign-out) — edge adv -t 'upstream 429'.
9. Auth upstream never answers → edge settles 503 + Retry-After inside its 6 s auth deadline (+1.5 s slack) — edge adv -t 'never answers'.
10. RPC failure under GET /v1/me/access → generic 5xx body, no internal detail, Cache-Control no-store — edge adv -t 'RPC failure'.
11. POST /v1/shots:sync with 5 000 001-byte body → 413 (no 500, no stall); truncated JSON / non-object body → 400 with generic message — edge adv -t '5 MB|truncated'.
12. Upstash hang → every limiter call settles within the 1.2 s timeout and the memory fallback still returns 429 to a runaway client; Upstash HTTP 500 → auth cache reads/writes degrade to L1 without throwing — edge adv -t 'Upstash'.
13. Runtime fact pinned: react-native/Libraries/Network/fetch.js requires whatwg-fetch (3.6.20, fetch.polyfill=true) and its Response has no `redirected` property — transportBounds -t 'runtime fact'.
All Deno adv commands: `cd supabase/functions/api/__wf__ && deno test -A --no-check --config deno.json adv_networking_recovery.test.ts`; all Jest adv commands run from apps/mobile with `npx jest --ci <file>`.

NOT_YET_VERIFIABLE (needs Mac/device; no verdict guessed): (a) whether NSURLSession under RN 0.87's XHR-based fetch re-sends the Authorization header / JSON body to a cross-origin 307/308 redirect target — needs a device/simulator run against a local redirecting server: `cd apps/mobile && bundle exec pod install --project-directory=ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/PickleSensei.xcworkspace -scheme PickleSensei -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -configuration Debug build` then point API_BASE_URL at a host that 307-redirects /v1/shots:sync to a second local origin and inspect that origin's access log; (b) the stalled-body P3 on a real device (whatwg-fetch resolves only after the full body, so the on-device manifestation is 'no timeout at all until the OS drops the socket' — same run as (a) with a server that sends headers then holds the body); (c) process-death/relaunch of the outbox mid-drain and OS-level offline transitions (NWPathMonitor) — `scripts/mac-full-verify.sh` on the M4 runner (not invoked from here per instructions). Not in this area / not attempted: StoreKit, RevenueCat, production Supabase.

INVALID PROBES REMOVED OR RECLASSIFIED (not reported as breaks): an initial expectation that ApiError carries Retry-After (it is {status,code,message}) was converted into passing control #2; the stalled-body assertions were labelled [streaming-fetch only] and downgraded to P3 after pinning the RN fetch runtime; the session-create/finalize HTML probes were kept but graded P3 because the client contract for those rows is 'any 2xx = delivered' and a lost session is reconstructed via recoverSession. Note for the coordinator: root Prettier and `deno fmt` disagree on the new __wf__ file; root Prettier (the CI gate per AGENTS.md) was applied.
